summary: Completes reused Helm chart verification and binds release receipts to the exact immutable OCI registry archives delivered to customers.
userImpact: Protected plugin-toolchain publication can complete when an existing immutable chart has canonically identical content but different archive metadata.
Connected and offline release receipts now contain and hash the exact chart archives retrieved from the immutable registry subjects.
security: Both chart verification gates use the fail-closed canonical comparison for content equivalence.
The release receipt separately records SHA-256 values for the exact immutable registry layer bytes that customers receive.
documentation: The generated release notes distinguish canonical chart equivalence from exact registry-byte receipt integrity.
rollback: Revert the workflow correction to return to the previous publication behavior; already published application images, toolchain images, and charts remain immutable.
validation: Canonical Helm archive tests covering metadata-only repacks, content and mode changes, links, added or unsafe paths, and malformed tar headers
Protected plugin-toolchain policy checks covering both registry verification gates and registry-byte release receipts
Published v0.16.2 plugin-toolchain workflow, signatures, distribution lock, deployment kit, and offline bundle
